news.title: Sebi board meeting: Open market buyback is back and intraday borrowing for MFs; 5 key decisions investors should know
news.summary: Sebi approved a series of reforms to improve market efficiency and investor protection. Key changes include the return of exchange-based buybacks, intraday borrowing for mutual funds, faster AIF launches, easier municipal bond fundraising and simplified transmission of securities to legal heirs.

news.title: SBI Mutual Fund eyes IPO launch by July first week; Sebi approval likely today: Sources

news.title: Turtlemint Fintech IPO subscribed 0.46 times on Day 1; retail investors lead demand
news.summary: Turtlemint Fintech Solutions' IPO opened on June 19 and garnered a modest response, with 0.46 times subscription by day's end. The company aims to raise ₹882.67 crore, primarily for acquisitions and expansion, with shares listed on NSE and BSE on June 29.

news.title: Small-cap FMCG stock ends in green territory after promoter's stake raise move
news.summary: GRM Overseas shares rose to ₹93 after promoter Atul Garg increased his stake by 0.05%. Currently, promoters hold 62.5% of the company. For FY26, GRM reported a 31.22% revenue growth but faced selling pressure, with shares down 42% in June.
